slot.brief: Ask which of the listed compounds is used as a tranquilizer/hypnotic; include barbiturate and analgesic look-alikes as distractors.

stem: Which compound is used as a tranquilizer, rather than as a barbiturate hypnotic or an analgesic?

verdicts.working: Diazepam is used as a tranquilizer; phenobarbital is a barbiturate, while aspirin and ibuprofen are analgesics.

working:
Diazepam is a benzodiazepine tranquilizer.\nPhenobarbital is a barbiturate; aspirin and ibuprofen are analgesics.

Independent check: Diazepam is used as a tranquilizer; phenobarbital is a barbiturate, while aspirin and ibuprofen are analgesics.
solution: Diazepam is a benzodiazepine used as a tranquilizer. Phenobarbital is a barbiturate, while aspirin and ibuprofen are analgesics.
